question.:question/problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186105903-draft/plots/751a7ef332f20f9d0577e2b8cbe9c2b358f213674d80ae81c5a4254e58b0daf0.png)

Find the area of $△ABC.$ Round your answer to two decimal places.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}bc\operatorname{sin}⁡A,
$$

where $∠A$ is between the sides of lengths $b$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}с & =AB=56, \\ b & =AC=26, \\ m∠A & ={122}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{122}^{∘}=0.848\,048,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 26\cdot 56\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{122}^{∘} \\  & =728\cdot (0.848\,048) \\  & ≈617.38,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.
